title: Founder Runtime Execution Approval Gate
objective: Define and later validate a governed founder runtime execution approval gate while keeping runtime execution blocked until a later explicitly scoped phase grants narrow authority.
safetyRules: Do not enable approval capture, approval persistence, runtime execution, execution unlock, worker/tool execution, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or provider spend in P117.1.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show raw private project IDs, runtime approval record keys, raw DB table names, raw JSON, raw logs, or raw policy dumps in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions or live approval/run buttons.
knownLimitations: Runtime execution approval, approval capture, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and provider spend remain blocked.

subphases.title: Approval Evidence Schema Metadata
subphases.narrowGoal: Define local schema metadata for runtime execution approval evidence without writes or approval capture.
subphases.dataShape: Local schema metadata for runtime execution approval evidence items, approval evidence events, and approval evidence references. The schema records display-safe labels, owner, next action, disabled reason, evidence/activity references, and explicit false authority flags for approval capture, approval persistence, runtime execution, execution unlock, providers, agents, workers/tools, projects, package/deploy/release/export, network, and spend.
